title: フェブラリーSの後に・ツギツギ

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: It's just like you said! One race down!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Good luck at the next one! I'll be watching!
Things are off to a great start, and the crowd is certainly pleased. But as for Smart Falcon herself…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Looks like our next race is the Teio Sho in June!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: 2,000 meters… It's a little on the long side, so we need a strategy, stat!
Smart Falcon is not exactly wild with excitement, despite securing a fantastic first win.
Instead, she's already looking ahead, eyeing her next win.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yoohoo, you okay? Come on, let's head back to the academy!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Quick as lightning! ☆ In a flash! ♪
She's at least acting like her usual self, so I can't bring myself to say anything to her. For now, I switch gears to focus on the Teio Sho.
